title: Fix the typo in bud test
body:
The command for get buildah inspect results from jq have typo in test "bud with no instructions but with CLI flags that require a new image be written". Fix it in this commit.


(cherry picked from commit a726b07d8804e7dfd82e96e1ace4896e0549da70)

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This is a minor change to the jq expressions used in the test "bud with no instructions but with CLI flags that require a new image be written". The commit I'm cherry-picking from describes it as a typo, which isn't entirely accurate. It's using a newer feature of jq that treats `foo.["bar"]` as equivalent to `foo["bar"]`. This change was proposed in https://github.com/jqlang/jq/issues/1168 and made in jq 1.7. The syntax is causing failures in environments with jq 1.6, such as centos-stream 9.

#### How to verify it

Run the test on a system with jq 1.6.
